purpose: Huawei Cloud parametric pricing templates for architecture cost estimation
notes: Templates are parametric. Architects should provide variables such as quantity, size_gb, bandwidth_mbps, storage_gb, and monthly_hours.
product_infos_template will be completed later using Huawei Cloud Price Calculator/API Explorer payloads.
The MCP must not create, modify, delete, purchase, subscribe, or renew resources.

monthly_hours.description: Usage duration in hours for pay-per-use ECS pricing.

system_disk_gb.description: System disk size. Usually priced as EVS separately if calculator separates it.

resource_spec.description: Huawei Cloud ECS flavor with OS suffix. Example: s6.large.2.linux. The value must exist in the selected region.

monthly_hours.description: Usage duration in hours for pay-per-use OS license pricing.

ecs-flavor-period.description: ECS compute flavor monthly subscription (period billing). Architect provides ecs_resource_spec (flavor with .linux suffix). Does NOT include OS license (use ecs-os-license-period for SUSE/Windows) or system disk (use evs-gpssd-gb-payg or evs-ssd-gb-payg).

ecs_resource_spec.description: ECS flavor resource_spec with OS suffix. Examples: m6.3xlarge.8.linux, c6.3xlarge.4.linux, s6.xlarge.4.linux. Must exist in the selected region.

period_num.description: Number of periods. For period_type=2 (month), period_num=1 means 1 month.

ecs-os-license-period.description: ECS OS license monthly subscription (period billing) for commercial Linux distributions (SUSE, Windows). AlmaLinux and other free distributions do NOT generate a license productInfo (cost = USD 0, no template needed).

period_num.description: Number of periods. For period_type=2 (month), period_num=1 means 1 month.

monthly_hours.description: Usage duration in hours. Required by BSS/OCE product_infos but ignored by period API for OS license pricing.

vpc-bandwidth-traffic-gb-payg.description: VPC bandwidth traffic (upflow) billed per GB. Covers VPN traffic and EIP traffic billed by volume. Does NOT create EIP, quote EIP base bandwidth, or replace eip-bandwidth-mbps-payg. Use 12_bgp for Dynamic BGP traffic, 12_share for shared bandwidth traffic. Both resource_specs validated in la-north-2 at USD 0.081/GB.

traffic_resource_spec.description: VPC bandwidth traffic resource_spec. Valid values: 12_bgp (Dynamic BGP traffic), 12_share (shared bandwidth traffic). Both validated in la-north-2. Must be validated for other regions before use.

notes: VPC bandwidth traffic (upflow) pay-per-use template.
This template represents traffic by GB associated to VPC bandwidth/EIP billing.
Serves for VPN traffic/upflow and EIP traffic billed by volume.
Does NOT create EIP resources.
Does NOT quote EIP base bandwidth (Mbps/duration).
Does NOT quote bandwidth by Mbps — use eip-bandwidth-mbps-payg for that.
Does NOT replace eip-bandwidth-mbps-payg.
resource_spec 12_bgp = Dynamic BGP traffic (standby/secondary VPN tunnel, EIP BGP traffic).
resource_spec 12_share = shared bandwidth traffic (active/primary VPN tunnel, EIP shared traffic).
Both 12_bgp and 12_share have the same per-GB rate (USD 0.081/GB) in la-north-2.
12_bgp and 12_share must be validated for the target region before use.
usage_factor=upflow for traffic volume billing.
usage_value represents traffic volume in GB.
usage_measure_id=10 means GB.
No resource_size or size_measure_id — traffic uses usage_value only.
Validated: 12_bgp 200GB = USD 16.20, 12_bgp 300GB = USD 24.30.
Validated: 12_share 200GB = USD 16.20, 12_share 300GB = USD 24.30.
Validated: 2 × 12_bgp 300GB = USD 48.60 (real EIP quote: USD 48.61, 0.01 rounding diff).
VPN Fase 2 can use this template for VPN traffic components instead of raw product_infos.
